Name: Stardew Bakery
Author: Yaramy
Description: This mod adds a winter plant, the cookie plant, which gives white cookies, required to bake many recipes that give buffs. Those recipes are sold by various npc's at a cost of 150g. Other recipes that don't give buffs are also added. Some npc's sell the pastries. Also, three weapons are added, intended to be used before Galaxy weapons. Made from candy cane, are sold by Marlon.
